prerequisites: The student must have a good knowledge of the most relevant topics of mathematics and physics; in particular, she/he must know derivatives, integrals, partial differential equations, basic principles of mechanics and thermodynamics.

learning_outcomes.text: have a deep knowledge of fluid properties and the govern equations of fluid flow
be able to apply the acquired competencies to investigate a interpret fluid dynamic problems to be faced in engineering
have the ability to read and understand textbooks on related topics

syllabus_topics: Eulerian and Lagrangian description of fluid kinematics
assessment_rules: The oral exam will consist of questions to assess the acquired knowledge and comprehension of the main topics in fluid dynamics. Moreover, the exam will aim to assess the capability to solve elementary problems in fluid mechanics.
bibliography: Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics (7 th edition), by Bruce R. Munson, Alric P. Rothmayer, Theodore H. Okiishi, Wade W. Huebsch, Ed. John Wiley & Sons, Inc.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Industriale (Industrial Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
